description: mta_sts_error.rs defines TlsRequiredNotAdvertised and TlsCertInvalid(String) but neither is ever constructed. relay_client.rs returns SmtpRelayError::Permanent strings for REQUIRETLS failures; cert failures return SmtpRelayError::TlsHandshake. Dead variants mislead readers about which error paths are live and invite incorrect future usage (e.g. someone wiring them to the wrong handler).
title: MtaStsError::TlsRequiredNotAdvertised and TlsCertInvalid are dead variants
